_comment: Quick actions for the Chrome extension (spec §E7). CONFIG, NOT CODE: a rule matches the tab's ADDRESS ONLY — the page is never read — and extracts one entity from the URL (the capture group named by `$1`).

An action is shown only to users who have EVERY tool in `requires` (the same per-user tool list the model is offered); the server filters, so a write action a role cannot perform never reaches the panel.

`kind` read: clicking sends `message` as the user's message with the entity attached. `kind` write: `compose` is put into the composer and focused, nothing is sent. Placeholders: {callsign} {date} {adep} {ades} {key} for leon-flight, {icao} for icao.
`Save to Knowledge base…` from an AIP portal (the design's third AD 2 action) is NOT offered: no tool can save a document from a URL — knowledge uploads take a file through the Knowledge base page.

actions.label: AIP for {icao}
actions.message: Open the AIP AD 2 document for {icao}.
